title: answer.v1
description: What the model writes for a question that is not a full analysis (ADR-052: Report 1 JSON or a short answer; build step 7 decision D9): the locale the text is written in, a short text with {value id} placeholders, the lines it rests on, and at most one action from a closed list. This is the SHAPE of lib/reply/contracts/answer.ts. The rules that need the packet (the locale must be the reply locale, the cited ids and the placeholders must exist in it), the number of placeholders in a text (at most 8), the tag characters U+E0000 to U+E007F, and the specific FORBIDDEN_KEY report for a direction-like key are enforced by validateAnswer and are NOT expressed here. Lengths count Unicode code points here and UTF-16 code units there; they agree for text outside the astral planes.

plainText.description: One line of plain text: no control, line-separator, bidirectional embedding, override or isolate character, no byte order mark.

placeholders.description: A brace belongs to a well-formed {value id}, or the text is refused.
